zh.title: 企业知识库问答系统
zh.subtitle: 从资料整理到引用溯源，设计可验证的企业知识问答应用。
zh.scenario: 面向企业内部制度、产品文档和常见问题，设计一个带资料管理、检索问答和引用查看界面的知识服务。重点处理回答无依据、文档版本混淆和敏感信息泄露等问题。
modules: 资料管理：文件接入、版本记录与解析状态
检索问答：文本分段、检索策略与上下文组织
引用溯源：展示来源片段并支持人工核对
质量评估：有答案、无答案及冲突资料的测试集
goals: 理解 RAG 从文档到回答的处理链路
设计带引用与拒答机制的问答交互
使用 AI 辅助编写测试用例并人工核验
prerequisites: 掌握 Python 和 HTTP JSON 基础
了解提示词结构与前端表单
deliverables: 系统模块图和接口清单
资料样例与不少于 10 条评测问题
问答页面原型、引用展示规则及测试计划
zh.question: 请帮助我拆解知识库问答的模块，并说明哪些结果必须人工验证。

en.title: Enterprise Knowledge Assistant
en.subtitle: Design evidence-based enterprise Q&A with document management and traceable citations.
en.scenario: Design a knowledge service for internal policies, product documentation and frequently asked questions. Include document management, retrieval-based Q&A and source inspection, addressing unsupported answers, conflicting versions and sensitive information.
modules: Document management: ingestion, version tracking and parsing status
Retrieval and Q&A: chunking, retrieval strategy and context assembly
Source inspection: cited passages and human verification
Evaluation: answerable, unanswerable and conflicting-document cases
goals: Explain the RAG pipeline from documents to answers
Design citation and abstention interactions
Use AI to draft tests and verify results manually
deliverables: System diagram and API inventory
Sample documents and at least 10 evaluation questions
Q&A screen prototype, citation rules and test plan
en.question: Help me break down a knowledge assistant into modules and identify results that need human verification.

zh.title: 云服务智能运维台
zh.subtitle: 围绕监控、日志与故障分析，设计可追溯的 AI 运维工作台。
zh.scenario: 面向教学用云服务，设计统一展示服务状态、日志证据和故障工单的运维台。AI 负责提出排查假设和建议，实际执行由用户确认，禁止直接操作真实生产环境。
modules: 服务概览：健康状态、指标趋势与异常提示
日志检索：时间窗口、关键字段和证据关联
智能诊断：区分事实、假设和待验证项
处置记录：人工确认、执行结果与复盘归档
goals: 建立监控、日志与事件之间的关联
设计有证据约束的诊断提示词
定义人工审批和恢复验证流程
prerequisites: 了解 Linux 常用命令和 HTTP 服务
能够阅读 JSON 日志与简单 Python 代码
deliverables: 运维台页面原型与状态模型
三类故障场景及脱敏日志样例
排查清单、审批规则与恢复验收标准
zh.question: 请根据模拟日志设计排障流程，明确事实、假设和需要人工确认的操作。

en.title: Cloud Operations Copilot
en.subtitle: Design an evidence-driven AI operations console for monitoring, logs and incident triage.
en.scenario: Design a console for teaching services that connects service status, log evidence and incident tickets. AI proposes hypotheses and actions; users approve execution. Do not operate real production infrastructure.
modules: Service overview: health, metric trends and anomaly indicators
Log search: time windows, key fields and linked evidence
Diagnosis: separate facts, hypotheses and pending checks
Response records: approvals, execution results and review
goals: Connect metrics, logs and events
Design evidence-constrained diagnostic prompts
Define human approval and recovery verification
prerequisites: Basic Linux commands and HTTP services
Ability to read JSON logs and simple Python
deliverables: Console prototype and state model
Three incident scenarios with sanitized sample logs
Triage checklist, approval rules and recovery criteria
en.question: Design a triage workflow from simulated logs, separating facts, hypotheses and actions requiring approval.

zh.title: MCP 工具服务开发
zh.subtitle: 围绕工具、资源与提示模板，设计可测试的智能体服务接口。
zh.scenario: 以知识条目查询和任务记录为场景，设计一个供智能体使用的 MCP 服务。通过明确的工具输入输出、权限范围和错误反馈，降低模型误调用和越权访问风险。
modules: 工具契约：输入 Schema、返回结构与错误分类
资源组织：资源标识、读取范围和更新约定
提示模板：参数约束和上下文说明
调用测试：正常、非法参数、越权和超时场景
goals: 区分 Tools、Resources 与 Prompts 的职责
设计最小权限的工具调用接口
编写覆盖错误分支的契约测试方案
prerequisites: 掌握 Python 或 TypeScript 基础
了解 JSON Schema 和客户端服务端通信
deliverables: MCP 服务设计说明与接口契约
至少三个工具的输入输出示例
权限矩阵、错误码清单和测试用例
zh.question: 请帮我设计三个最小权限 MCP 工具，并补充输入校验和失败测试用例。

en.title: MCP Tool Service Development
en.subtitle: Design testable agent interfaces for tools, resources and prompt templates.
en.scenario: Design an MCP service for knowledge lookup and task records. Define explicit tool inputs, outputs, permissions and errors to reduce incorrect calls and unauthorized access.
modules: Tool contracts: input schemas, response structures and error categories
Resources: identifiers, read scopes and update conventions
Prompt templates: parameters and context guidance
Call tests: valid input, invalid input, denied access and timeouts
goals: Distinguish Tools, Resources and Prompts
Design least-privilege tool interfaces
Plan contract tests covering failure paths
deliverables: MCP service design and interface contracts
Input/output examples for at least three tools
Permission matrix, error codes and test cases
en.question: Help me design three least-privilege MCP tools with input validation and failure test cases.

zh.title: 多智能体工单协作系统
zh.subtitle: 设计分类、分派、协作与人工审核相结合的工单处理流程。
zh.scenario: 面向校园 IT 服务请求，设计带工单列表、处理详情和审批记录的协作系统。将分类、资料检索、方案起草分配给不同角色，最终结论由人工审核，保留完整流转证据。
modules: 工单受理：字段校验、分类与优先级
任务编排：角色职责、交接状态和失败重试
协作处理：资料证据、方案草稿与冲突处理
人工审核：退回、确认、关闭和审计记录
goals: 设计可追踪的多角色协作状态机
为智能体划分职责和工具权限
处理重复请求、失败重试和人工接管
prerequisites: 理解 REST API、状态管理与提示词
具备基础前端和 Python 编程能力
deliverables: 工单状态机和角色权限图
五类工单样例及角色提示词
页面原型、交接协议与异常处理测试计划
zh.question: 请帮我设计工单协作状态机，包含重试、退回和人工接管，避免多个角色重复处理。

en.title: Multi-Agent Ticket Workflow
en.subtitle: Design ticket classification, assignment and collaboration with human review.
en.scenario: Design a campus IT request system with ticket lists, processing details and approval records. Assign classification, evidence retrieval and response drafting to distinct roles while retaining human approval and a traceable history.
modules: Intake: field validation, classification and priority
Orchestration: role ownership, handoffs and retries
Collaboration: evidence, response drafts and conflict handling
Human review: return, approve, close and audit
goals: Design a traceable multi-role state machine
Define agent responsibilities and tool permissions
Handle duplicate requests, retries and human takeover
prerequisites: REST APIs, state management and prompts
deliverables: Ticket state machine and role permission diagram
Five sample tickets and role prompts
Screen prototypes, handoff contracts and failure test plan
en.question: Help me design a ticket workflow with retries, returns and human takeover while preventing duplicate work.
